titulo: Orações relativas: who, which, that, where e whose: Revisão e prática da aula 45

aula.titulo: Orações relativas: who, which, that, where e whose
aula.objetivo: Definir pessoas, coisas, lugares e posse com orações relativas («the man who…», «the book that…», «the city where…», «the woman whose…»), omitindo o pronome quando possível.

itens.audio: The man who lives next door is a doctor
opcoes: The man who lives next door is a doctor
The man which lives next door is a doctor
The man lives next door is a doctor
itens.gabarito: The man who lives next door is a doctor

itens.audio: This is the city where I was born
opcoes: This is the city where I was born
This is the city which I was born
This is the city where I born
itens.gabarito: This is the city where I was born

itens.audio: The book that I read was great
itens.respostaEsperada: The book that I read was great
itens.explicacao: Escreva: the book that I read was great.

itens.audio: The girl whose bag was stolen is crying
itens.respostaEsperada: The girl whose bag was stolen is crying
itens.explicacao: Escreva: the girl whose bag was stolen is crying.

itens.enunciado: Qual frase pode omitir o pronome?
opcoes: The book (that) I read was great.
The man (who) called me is my boss.
The girl (whose) bag was stolen is here.
itens.gabarito: The book (that) I read was great.

opcoes: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
The man who he lives next door is a doctor.
The man whose lives next door is a doctor.
itens.gabarito: The man who lives next door is a doctor.

itens.enunciado: The woman ___ called me is my boss.
This is the book ___ I read.
The girl ___ bag was stolen is crying.
A restaurant is a place ___ you eat.
Ordene: «The book that I read was great.»
itens.gabarito: The book that I read was great.

itens.enunciado: Ordene: «The man who called me is my boss.»
itens.gabarito: The man who called me is my boss.

itens.enunciado: Defina 4 palavras com relativas: uma pessoa, uma coisa, um lugar e uma com whose.
itens.respostaEsperada: A waiter is a person who serves food. A dictionary is a book that explains words. A restaurant is a place where you eat. An orphan is a child whose parents have died.

blocos.enunciado: Descreva em 1 minuto a sua casa, o seu bairro e as pessoas que moram lá, com orações relativas.
Defina 5 objetos da sua casa sem dizer o nome.
